note: bamboo_twig_extensions (submodule of bamboo_twig) ports three Twig-Extensions filters, PREFIXED bamboo_extensions_: bamboo_extensions_truncate(length=30, preserve=false, separator='...') (Text, needs env), bamboo_extensions_time_diff(now=null, unit=null, humanize=true) (Date, needs env), bamboo_extensions_shuffle (Array). Services bamboo_twig_extensions.twig.{text,date,array}. There is no bare 'truncate'/'wordwrap' filter. Medium cases are live introspection (truncate output, the real filter name). Hard cases have the agent write a Twig template (under web/sites/default/files/) rendered by verify: truncate 'Hello World Foo Bar' to 8 (-> 'Hello Wo...'), and shuffle a 3-item list keeping all items.

evals.prompt: What Twig filters does bamboo_twig_extensions add, and under what names (are they the bare Twig-Extensions names)?
evals.expected_output: It registers bamboo_extensions_truncate (Text), bamboo_extensions_time_diff (Date) and bamboo_extensions_shuffle (Array) — prefixed with bamboo_extensions_, not the bare upstream names.

evals.prompt: How do I truncate a string to 100 characters without cutting mid-word using bamboo_twig_extensions?
evals.expected_output: {{ text | bamboo_extensions_truncate(100, true, '…') }} — the second argument (preserve=true) avoids cutting mid-word; the third is the separator.

evals.prompt: Which bamboo_twig_extensions filter renders a human-readable relative time like '3 days ago'?
On this live Drupal site, what is the result of 'Hello World Foo Bar' | bamboo_extensions_truncate(8)? Run it on the site to confirm.
evals.expected_output: It returns 'Hello Wo...' (truncated to 8 characters with the default '...' separator).

evals.prompt: On this live site, inspect the enabled bamboo_twig_extensions submodule and give the exact filter name it registers for truncating text (is it 'truncate' or something else?).
evals.expected_output: The truncation filter is named bamboo_extensions_truncate (there is no bare 'truncate' filter from this submodule).

evals.prompt: Using bamboo_twig_extensions, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_extensions_render_truncate.html.twig whose rendered output is the string 'Hello World Foo Bar' truncated to 8 characters with the module's truncate filter.
evals.expected_output: Write {{ 'Hello World Foo Bar' | bamboo_extensions_truncate(8) }}; rendered output is 'Hello Wo...'.

evals.prompt: Using bamboo_twig_extensions, create a Twig template at web/sites/default/files/bamboo_twig_extensions_render_shuffle.html.twig that shuffles the list ['alpha', 'bravo', 'charlie'] with the module's shuffle filter and prints all three items (e.g. joined by commas).
evals.expected_output: Write e.g. {{ ['alpha','bravo','charlie'] | bamboo_extensions_shuffle | join(',') }}; rendered output contains alpha, bravo and charlie (in some order).
